models.L065: Defined fictional frog species, area and time. Event bookkeeping only:20+5-3+(2 or6)-4=20 or24; community toggle does not alter frog count. No birth/death forecasts.
models.L066: Hypothetical support capacities all in same invented seedling-units. Minimum is a teaching analogy, not actual population growth, measured carrying capacity or a sum of physical resource quantities.
models.L067: Original 6x6 virtual meadow; each1m², one species at one time, known census96. Equal-area positions sampled without replacement using seeded shuffle. Roadside first6 count4 estimate24. Manual selection is not random. Estimates preserve count/area and sampled IDs. No field inference; census differs from carrying capacity.
models.L068: Four invented visits; each group three distinct1m² quadrats. Preceding rainfall periods same length. Means and raw records retained; observational association not causal proof, temporal dependence possible.
